Changes.note: Add registers the partner application enabled and working with no köşk; from then on its token is accepted on the /integrations/* routes. Turning it off refuses its token and offers its codes in no course; the enrolments it made stay, and it can be turned on again. Renaming changes the name shown in course settings and in the audit log. In Choose köşks, a köşk taken off loses this application's codes on its courses, and choosing the köşk again brings none back. Every change is written to the audit log; another server sees it within a minute. A partner application is never deleted.

PartnersPage.addIntro: An added application is on and works with no köşk. Choose its köşks next.
PartnersPage.addedBody: {name} is on. Now choose the köşks it works with.
PartnersPage.clientIdHelp: The ID of the application's Keycloak client: letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.
PartnersPage.errors.clientId.shape: A client ID holds only letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, and starts with a letter or a digit.
PartnersPage.errors.exists: A partner application with this client ID is registered already.
PartnersPage.errors.frontEnd: This client is one of Medaris's own applications; it cannot be a partner application.
PartnersPage.intro: Partner applications whose registrations become course enrolments in Medaris. A partner application works only with the köşks chosen for it: its codes appear only in those köşks' course settings and enrol students only there.
PartnersPage.kosksIntro: In a köşk that is unticked, this application's codes are removed from the courses and written to the audit log; ticking the köşk again does not bring them back. The enrolments it made earlier stay, and their cancellations still reach them.
PartnersPage.nameHelp: The course settings and the audit log show this name. At most 100 characters.
PartnersPage.title: Partner applications
PartnersPage.turnedOffBody: {name} can no longer enrol students, and its codes appear in no course. The enrolments it made stay.
PartnersPage.turnedOnBody: {name} can enrol students again in its chosen köşks.
